column1: # Smoke set: the synthetic 4-voice recording, one line per turn.

column4: Okay everyone, let's plan the hiking trip for next Saturday. I was thinking we try the lake trail this time.
The lake trail sounds great, but it's pretty long. How many miles is it in total?
It's about eleven miles round trip. I did it last spring and it took us most of the day.
Eleven miles is fine for me, as long as we start early. Maybe we leave at seven in the morning?
Seven works for me. Ben, can you drive? Your car has the most room for four people.
Sure, I can drive. I'll pick everyone up, starting with Callum since he lives closest to the highway.
Thanks Ben. I'll bring the big cooler and some sandwiches for lunch at the lake.
I can bring water and snacks. Does anyone have a water filter, in case we run out?
I have one. I'll also check the weather forecast on Thursday and send it to the group.
Good idea. If it looks like rain, we could do the shorter canyon trail instead.
The canyon trail is nice too, and it's only five miles. Either way, we should bring rain jackets.
Agreed. So the plan is seven a.m. pickup, lake trail if it's sunny, canyon trail if it rains.
Perfect. And let's try to be back by five, because I have dinner plans that evening.
That should be easy. Eleven miles with a lunch break is about seven hours.
Then we're all set. I'll make a packing list and share it tonight.
Great, thanks everyone. See you all on Saturday.
